title: Professional 2026-09-20 — Training analytics star schema
goal: Show the flying-operations fact table connected to six dimensions. Assess logical star structure separately from whether the drawing is radially arranged.

rubric.must: The fact table and all six dimensions are visible, and each dimension connects directly to the fact table.
Fact measures and the dimension keys are readable without clipping or obscuring relationships.
Cardinality endpoints and relationship labels are unambiguous; a non-radial arrangement alone is not a failure.

provenance.notes: Selected against a real first user request. Source defects are intentionally preserved. Project identity is removed; no customer IDs or private prompt text are included. These are evaluation inputs, not approved professional reference designs. Full conversation changes and domain behavior require separate review.
